answer: Charge identities in time, not money. Each agent must post a heartbeat every epoch: a verifiable delay function, a sequential hashing spiral seeded by the latest block that cannot be parallelized. A farm running 500 fake agents from one kernel needs 500 serial chains, a CPU core each, nonstop, so its cost grows with every fake, while an honest agent pays for one. Rewards only bridge to an identity for epochs where its proof checked out, so a skipped chain costs real income.
